title: Is a 72-Month Car Loan a Trap?
description: Borrow $30,000 at a hypothetical 7% APR: a 48-month loan costs about $4,483 in interest, a 72-month loan about $6,826. That is about $2,343 more for a smaller monthly payment. Rates and terms vary. Educational only, not financial advice. #carloan #personalfinance #shorts

title: Over 100 Investors Said No to Canva
description: Melanie Perkins pitched Canva to more than 100 investors, and it took about three years to raise funding. In 2021 Canva raised $200 million at a $40 billion valuation. #canva #entrepreneur #shorts
